_about: Survival horror and slasher: a hunter, a closed place, and dwindling supplies. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

hunter: a figure in a work uniform
something that wears the faces of the dead
a family that will not let guests leave
a creature that hunts by sound
a former friend who came back wrong
a swarm that acts as one
a man who cannot be hurt by daylight things
place: a summer camp out of season
a hospital on its last night open
a mining town at the bottom of a valley
a research hut on the ice
a farm a long way from the road
rule: it never runs, and it is always there
it only takes those who are alone
it cannot enter where it was not invited
it repeats the last thing that hurt it
it comes when the lights go out
betrayal: one of them called it here
the map they trusted was wrong
someone will trade the others to live
last_hope: a radio tower on the ridge
a car with a quarter tank

1: a sign someone was here and left in a hurry
a scream far off that nobody else heard
2: the first of them is gone
3: it gets inside the safe room
4: face it, or run with what is left
the last hope fails or holds

cliches: it was the janitor all along
